excerpt: B(K+ -> pi+ nu nubar) = (13.0+3.3-3.0) x 10^-11, combining data from 2016-2022; 51 signal candidates with an expected background of 18(+3/-2) events; the smallest branching ratio measured with a signal significance above 5 sigma.
title: Observation of the K+ -> pi+ nu nubar decay and measurement of its branching ratio
